2609.00879.title: Towards reliable multimodal disaster severity assessment through preference optimization and explainable vision-language reasoning
2609.00879.paper_summary: Reliable disaster damage assessment requires models that provide both accurate predictions and transparent explanations. However, existing multimodal approaches are limited by scarce annotated data and insufficient evaluation of reasoning quality. This study proposes a two-stage training framework that integrates Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) within a unified data construction pipeline. From a single Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) annotation workflow, two complementary datasets are derived, namely ReasoningSet, which contains validated rationales for SFT, and PreferenceSet, which comprises paired rationales for DPO-based alignment. The framework evaluates both classification performance and explanation quality using automatic metrics, model-based scoring, and human ranking. Experimental results show that SFT improves accuracy from 73.64% to 78.29% and increases Macro-F1 by 29% compared to the baseline, while explanation quality improves by approximately 25%. Subsequent DPO alignment further enhances interpretability on the PreferenceSet. Cross-model validation on InternVL-3-8B and LLaVA-1.5-7B demonstrates the robustness and generalizability of the approach. The proposed framework improves detection of underrepresented mild damage cases, reduces high-risk misclassifications, and strengthens alignment between model reasoning and human judgment. Overall, it provides a reproducible pathway to develop reliable multimodal systems that deliver auditable, actionable disaster insights for emergency management.
2609.00879.paper_summary_zh: 可靠的災害損害評估需要提供準確預測和透明解釋的模型。<lb/>然而，現有的多模態方法受到稀缺標註數據和推理質量評估不足的限制。<lb/>本研究提出了一個兩階段訓練框架，將監督微調（SFT）和直接偏好優化（DPO）整合在一個統一的數據構建流程中。<lb/>從單一的人類參與（HITL）標註工作流程中，衍生出兩個互補數據集，即ReasoningSet，該數據集包含經驗證的SFT理據，以及PreferenceSet，該數據集包含用於基於DPO的對齊的配對理據。<lb/>該框架使用自動指標、基於模型的評分和人類排名來評估分類性能和解釋質量。<lb/>實驗結果顯示，SFT將準確率從73.64%提高到78.29%，並將Macro-F1提高29%，與基準相比，解釋質量約提高25%。<lb/>隨後的DPO對齊進一步增強了PreferenceSet的可解釋性。<lb/>在InternVL-3-8B和LLaVA-1.5-7B上的交叉模型驗證展示了該方法的穩健性和普遍性。<lb/>所提出的框架改善了對代表性不足的輕微損害案例的檢測，減少了高風險的錯誤分類，並加強了模型推理與人類判斷之間的對齊。<lb/>總體而言，它提供了一條可重複的途徑，以開發可靠的多模態系統，為應急管理提供可審計、可行動的災害洞察。
